notes: Asymmetrical horror with one killer against four survivors is Survival's 1 vs All subgenre exactly, and the food-fight skin over it changes nothing about the space. warren-looping is the preset's own shape and the answers confirm it - a small classic-Roblox-HQ map with a few simple loops - so the P6 stays: the zero-dead-ends topology is what keeps a 1v4 chase fair and an image cannot guarantee it. gate-escape was dropped because the answers say survivors win on a round timer with no exit or objective system in this first build, which leaves spawn-protected as the thing that keeps the burger and the onion rings from starting on top of each other. Decided without a user: the HQ is treated as the whole map rather than a building entered from a surrounding exterior, so there is no outside-to-inside transition and no P3, and the slash stun, 25-damage punch and the ketchup projectile that the answers reassign to the killer are combat rather than layout.
